    Yeah bro, there IS a question mechanism. It's called clarify. Here's how it works:

    What it does:
    - When I need your input before proceeding, I can pause and ask you a question
    - You can pick from options (up to 4) or type your own answer
    - It blocks the agent until you respond — so yes, it literally pauses work

    When I use it:
    - The task is ambiguous and I need you to choose an approach
    - There are meaningful trade-offs you should weigh
    - I want your feedback on something

    When I DON'T use it:
    - Simple yes/no confirmations (terminal tool handles those)
    - Low-stakes decisions (I just make the default choice)

    The tradeoff:
    Using it means the session pauses — I can't do anything else until you answer. So I only use it when your input actually matters.

    Right now, I'm NOT using it. I'm just chatting with you freely. No blocking, no forced questions.

    You want me to use it more often, or just keep it casual?
